name: Can tile be installed over existing bathroom flooring?

mainEntity.name: Can tile be installed over existing bathroom flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is sometimes technically possible to install new tile over existing flooring, it is often not the ideal approach for a high-quality, lasting renovation. Installing over existing surfaces can lead to an uneven finish, raise floor heights to undesirable levels, or create issues if the underlying material is not perfectly stable. For a luxury bathroom remodel, AKN Design Group typically recommends removing old flooring to ensure a proper, level subfloor and a secure installation. This commitment to craftsmanship ensures structural integrity and a flawless aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing tile over existing flooring is generally not recommended for a lasting, high-quality result. We typically remove old flooring to ensure a proper, level base.
